text: {"user":"I’m planning a small bathroom refresh this month: replace the vanity and put a new seal around the tub. I already booked a cleaning service for a one-time deep clean before the work starts—should I keep that booking or switch the plan?","plus_response":"Since you’re already doing the vanity swap and new tub sealing, it may make sense to scale back the paid deep-clean service to avoid paying for something you can cover with a couple focused sessions. If you still want help, you could swap to a lighter “bathroom refresh” option rather than a full deep clean.","minus_response":"Keeping the one-time deep-clean booking before the vanity and tub sealing is a good idea—starting from a spotless bathroom helps the new seal go on cleanly and creates a more hygienic space after the work. Treat the cleaning as part of the project’s payoff, so your results last longer and feel better to use."}
